title: Phase 6.2 Anonymized Result Envelope
description: The input to the offline calibration analyzer. An ENVELOPE binds a set of anonymized result records to the exact curator-certified development pool WITHOUT identities: it carries the tracked manifest_id and the frozen public salted commitment (both public values; the salt is never present), plus provenance. Records use OPAQUE development ids only. The analyzer verifies manifest_id + commitment against the tracked development_pool_public_manifest.json before accepting any records.

public_commitment.description: The frozen public salted-sha256 commitment (matches the tracked manifest). The salt is never included.

prompt_contract_version.description: Version or hash of the system/prompt contract used to produce the predictions.

declared_gold_aggregate.description: The GOLD-label composition of the pool (not a prediction constraint).

dev_id.description: Opaque development id (e.g. DEV-0001). Never a canonical case id.

confidence.description: Raw confidence in [0,1], or null (MISSING). Non-numeric/boolean/out-of-range is INVALID and rejected; never coerced to 0.0.

correct.description: Optional; if present must equal 1 iff predicted_label == gold_label.

x_binding: The analyzer accepts records only if manifest_id and public_commitment equal the tracked development_pool_public_manifest.json values; the 8/15/2/2 aggregate is verified on GOLD labels only; predicted-label distribution is reported descriptively and never constrained.
